pick.name: Built-in auto memory + CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md
pick.what: Claude-written MEMORY.md plus topic files per repo (shared across worktrees), alongside your CLAUDE.md rules
pick.why: First-party, no daemon, plain markdown, loaded every session (first 200 lines/25KB)
pick.free_limits: Requires a Claude plan (Pro/Max plans/Team/Enterprise) or API billing; counts against plan usage

best_free.name: claude-mem (thedotmack)
best_free.what: Hook-based session capture, compression and search (local SQLite + Chroma) with MCP search tools
best_free.why: The most adopted dedicated memory add-on for Claude Code; runs fully local without an account
best_free.free_limits: Local use is free with no account (skip sign-in or set CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false); compression uses your Claude plan or your own OpenRouter/Gemini key; hosted observer (30-day trial), Cloud Sync and TeamBrain are paid (prices not published on README)
best_free.install: npx claude-mem install  (or /plugin marketplace add thedotmack/claude-mem, then /plugin install claude-mem)
best_free.license: Apache-2.0 (README points to docs/ip-boundary.md for commercial parts)

alts.name: claude-mem (thedotmack)
alts.what: Hook-captured observations, SQLite + Chroma semantic search over all past sessions
alts.why: Adds searchable session history that auto memory lacks
alts.free_limits: local free; hosted observer 30-day trial; cmem.ai cloud sync paid

alts.name: Basic Memory
alts.what: Markdown knowledge graph via MCP, readable in Obsidian
alts.why: Best if you want a human-curated notes vault the agent also uses

candidates.name: claude-mem
candidates.verdict: add-on only if you search past sessions; heavy (Bun+uv+Chroma+local HTTP worker)

candidates.name: Basic Memory
candidates.verdict: AGPL, MCP must be called explicitly

decision: Built-in auto memory plus CLAUDE.md is first-party, zero-maintenance and covers the core job. Add claude-mem only if you actually search past sessions: it costs a background worker, per-prompt hooks and model usage for compression. Serena's memories are a side feature of a code-navigation toolkit, not a memory product.
details: Pick itself needs Claude Code (a Claude plan or API billing); no separate charge.
